title.zh: 环境保护与管理（美国使馆车辆——豁免）命令 2020
title.en: Environmental Protection and Management (US Embassy Vehicles — Exemption) Order 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Environmental Protection and Management (US Embassy Vehicles — Exemption) Order 2020.

2.—(1) Regulation 4(1) of the Environmental Protection and Management (Vehicular Emissions) Regulations (Rg 6) does not apply to any relevant vehicle that conforms to the standard for exhaust emission specified in the Fifth Schedule to those Regulations.
(2) In this paragraph, “relevant vehicle” means —
(a)the vehicle bearing the engine number 1UR‑0603803 and chassis number URJ202‑4122840; or
(b)the vehicle bearing the engine number 1UR‑0674603 and chassis number URJ202‑4147141.
